thread:
Maya: Heads up — rolling out a config-only change in the next 30m for routing/batching safety cushion. No code changes.
Maya: Summary: lower per-tenant concurrency cap, add routing fallback for overloaded zones, tighten batch max_size for small-requests workload.
Maya: Details:
```
- per_tenant_concurrency: 8  # was 12
- global_route_fallback_enabled: true
- batch_max_size: 32 -> 20 for small_requests route
- request_timeout_ms: 30000 -> 28000
- grace_window_seconds: 60
```
Maya: Canary plan: 10% traffic for 20 minutes -> check latency & 5xx -> 50% for 15m -> full. Change window: 23:00-02:00 PT (low traffic).
Eli: tagging oncall and infra. @Oncall-Bot can you monitor error budget and paging thresholds?
Oncall-Bot: @Eli acknowledged. I will post SLO snapshots and page at 3x baseline error rate.
AJ: Where are the rollout flags? Need the exact flag keys for ops runbook.
Maya: flag: `cfg.rollout.safety_cushion.v1` and `cfg.routing.fallback.v1`. Added to release notes draft.
Sasha: Quick question — batch_max_size drop might increase CPU overhead on high qps nodes. Any sim results?
Maya: We ran offline sim on yesterday's slice (small_requests heavy). CPU 4% uptick on serving nodes, latency p50 unchanged, p95 + ~12ms. We think it's acceptable for the change window.
Harper: Add a soft cap to avoid double-queueing: `batch_queue_timeout_ms: 8` to keep latency bounded.
Maya: Good call — adding `batch_queue_timeout_ms: 8`. Updated config.
DeployBot: Starting canary for `cfg.rollout.safety_cushion.v1` at 10% across us-west-2/us-east-1. Immutable pin: none (config-only).
Eli: I'll watch dashboards: per-tenant tail latency, instance CPU, kv-cache hit rate, and error rate. Anyone want a quick alert tweak?
AJ: Update the infra-alert: increase pager threshold for a brief window so we don't page on known p95 noise. Keep dashboard alerts at default.
Sasha: Noted. I'll also pull the slow-path logs into the quick grep: `grep \"batch_timeout\" /var/log/serving/* | tail -n 200` if something odd shows.
DeployBot: Canary healthy at 10% after 5m. Latency stable, 5xx = baseline.
Maya: Sweet. Proceed to 50%?
Harper: +1 from me, observed minimal OS-level pressure on the canary fleet.
Eli: Going to 50% now.
DeployBot: Canary traffic raised to 50%.
Sasha: Seeing a small uptick in retransmits on one AZ (us-west-2b). Investigating.
Eli: If it affects p99 by >50ms on that AZ, we halt and roll back.
Sasha: It's a noisy NIC on a single host; I removed the host from rotor pool and traffic redistributed. p99 back to normal.
DeployBot: 50% steady at 10m. Metrics: p50 +3ms, p95 +15ms, 5xx +0.01% (within noise).
Maya: Going to full. Triggering full rollout now.
DeployBot: Full rollout started.
Harper: Note: added an automatic fallback policy to route to secondary-model-variant for tenants that hit concurrency cap to avoid hard failures.
AJ: Where are release notes for customers/internal? I'll paste into the changelog.
Maya: Release notes snippet: "Config-only: reduced per-tenant concurrency to improve fairness, routing fallback enabled in overload to preserve availability, batch sizes tuned for small-requests workloads to reduce cost spikes. Window: 23:00-02:00 PT. Rollout: canary->50%->100%. Monitored metrics: latency, errors, CPU."
Eli: Good. Post that to #release-notes after lunch.
Sasha: Quick post-deploy check: anyone see any unusual 429 patterns?
Maya: There was a slight increase in 429s for a handful of high-throughput tenants — within expected given lowered concurrency. We have a short-term mitigation: temporary traffic-weighted pinning to previous config for top 3 tenants if they hit >10% errors.
Harper: I can run a one-off pin: `cfg.rollout.safety_cushion.v1:override: tenant_id -> previous` for an affected tenant.
AJ: Put the pin plan in the runbook: who can drive the pin? Ops rotation + Maya.
Maya: Agreed. Pin steps in runbook: 1) Identify tenant_id, 2) run pin command, 3) notify tenant-success.
DeployBot: Rollout complete at full. No paged incidents.
Eli: Marking the change as "no rollback" unless we see >3x error rate or sustained p99 delta >200ms for 10 min.
Sasha: Logging this as a config-only deploy in the weekly deploy log.
Harper: I'll open a quick follow-up ticket to revisit batch_max_size after 24h of production traffic.
Maya: Thanks team. Small follow-up: add note to release notes about optional tenant pinning for troubleshooting.
AJ: Adding to changelog and runbook now. :thumbsup:
Maya: Closing thread — will ping #incidents if anything changes.
Oncall-Bot: Reminder — SLO snapshot posted. Monitoring until 03:00 PT.
